cuts.item: Spending freeze on non-essential items and hiring, except public safety and grant-funded

statements.statement: The state confirmed remaining FY20 local aid payments will be received; Chapter 70 and local aid for FY21 not yet discussed.
FY21 budget must be started from scratch, including revenue projections and forecasting.

warnings.prediction: Expected financial impact on the tax base from the pandemic, similar to 2007-2009, requiring a rebuilt budget.
